Bug_Title: ASE: Expression in assertion may produce a side effect (ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT)
Bug_Details:
Expressions used in assertions must not produce side effects. See SEI CERT Rule EXP06
for more information.
 SEI CERT Rule EXP06
Bug_Explanation: The assertion checks if a random number is greater than 0. The assertion contains a side effect because it changes the state of the random number generator.
Trigger_Explanation: The assertion in the 'testShowBug' method will fail because the 'rand.nextInt()' produces a side effect. This change in state of the 'Random' instance will lead to an assertion failure.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test execution results show that the assertion in the test method 'testShowBug' fails because the 'rand.nextInt()' produces a side effect. This side effect is not allowed in assertions as per the bug information and rule.
